plan: Given my private value of $21, I should bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while staying competitive. Bidding exactly my value risks zero profit if I win. A bid slightly under $21 can outcompete others who may bid below their values for profit. As all bidders are rational, they will likely bid below their values. I will bid $20.9 to maximize potential profit while considering the likelihood of winning.

Given my value of $22, I aim to bid just below my value to maximize profit while considering rational behavior of others. Bidders will likely bid close to their values, knowing overbidding leads to losses. I will bid $21.90, slightly below my value, to ensure potential profit if I win while minimizing overpayment risk.

Given my value for the prize is $13, I should bid slightly below this to maximize profit while maintaining a chance to win. Bidding exactly $13 risks zero profit if I win. Bidding much lower risks losing the auction. A bid around $12.5 balances these considerations, ensuring I only win if competitors bid less, thereby maximizing potential profit.
